columns.name: FORM_DATA_ID
columns.description: Link to the unique identifier of the submitted form data.

columns.name: ACTION_ID
columns.description: ID of a parent action_log record.

columns.name: ACTION_TIME
columns.description: Time Of The Action with Form (Gmt).

columns.name: OPERATION_TIME
columns.description: Time when this operation is performed by user (GMT).

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Sequential ID of transaction that defines an order of operations inside of the system.

columns.name: INTERFACE
columns.description: Interface the action is performed from.

columns.name: SCREEN_ID
columns.description: ID of the screen the action is performed from (reserved for a future use).

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: ID of the user the operation is performed by.

columns.name: USER_AGENT_ID
columns.description: Displays Of The User Agent Info.

columns.name: OPERATION
columns.description: Identifier of the performed operation.

columns.name: SUBMITTED_AT
columns.description: Date and Time Of the Form Submit.

columns.name: CREATED_AT
columns.description: Date and Time Of the Form Creation.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: Link to the ID of the related resource.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Link to the related activity ID - FFS_ACTIVITY->ACTIVITY_ID.

columns.name: INVENTORY_ID
columns.description: Reference to the related inventory ID - FFS_INVENTORY->INVENTORY_ID.

columns.name: FORM_DATA
columns.description: Submitted Form Data in JSON format.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: FORM_HISTORY_ID
columns.description: Contains unique identifier of the row. System generated.
